themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, including autonomous research, agents conducting research, and agentic workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on tools and platforms that leverage AI for various research purposes, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI applications that help developers write, debug, and review code, including research into these tools.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Highlights the use of AI in automating software testing processes, including validation and bug detection.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is affecting jobs, roles, skills, and the overall job market, including displacement and new opportunities.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's application in analyzing and understanding user sentiment from reviews, feedback, and other qualitative data.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, useful for research and insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of artificial users or consumers for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI-powered tools designed for creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in understanding product performance, market fit, and identifying new product opportunities.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
